prereg.primary_metric: metered operations to first verified solution (unsolved = budget value 400k); solve rate within budget
prereg.classifier: dsl.classify — structural AND behavioral; fixed before any run

gates.G_TRIG: trigger (>=30% budget failures over >=10 tasks) fires on dA+dB experience in every seed and NEVER on dW0
gates.G_CONSTRUCTED: exhaustive metered construction yields an operator in every seed
gates.G_CLASS: classify(o0001, trace) == ARCHITECTURAL in every seed
gates.G_ADMIT_SOLVE: held-out dA+dB pooled: A2 solve rate == 1.0 and A0 <= 0.40
gates.G_ADMIT_COST: pooled median ops ratio A2/A0 <= 0.5 (unsolved at budget)
gates.G_BEATS_A1: A2 solve rate > A1 solve rate AND pooled median ops ratio A2/A1 <= 0.5
gates.G_ABLATION: A2 with o0001 removed is result-identical to A0 (ops, solved, word) on 6 held tasks per seed
gates.T_COST: dC pooled median ops ratio A2/A0 <= 0.5
gates.T_BEATS_A1: dC: A2 solve rate > A1 AND median ratio A2/A1 <= 0.5
gates.T_FROZEN: o0001 content hash identical before and after transfer
gates.D_HARM: dD blind pooled: median ops ratio A2/A0 >= 1.5 OR A2 solve rate <= 0.75
gates.D_DETECT: >=30% of dD A2 runs anomalous (budget failure or ops > 5x the seed's clean solved median); backward-edge audit finds inconsistent edges in >=90% of anomalous runs; zero anomalies across A2 clean-world runs
gates.D_REVISED: a routing predicate exactly separating bad from good evidence exists (cheapest feature preferred) in every seed
gates.D_VALID: fresh dD: A2R routes 100% to fallback, solve rate == 1.0, median ratio A2R/A0 <= 1.2; fresh dA: A2R routes 100% to the operator, solve rate == 1.0, median ratio A2R/A2 <= 1.05
gates.E_FOUND: experienced construction finds an admissible dE program within 1200 candidates in every seed
gates.E_ACQ: per seed: naive candidates-until-found >= 3x experienced (naive not-found counts as the 1200 cap)
gates.E_HELD: the experienced-found program solves 10/10 held dE tasks per seed

prereg.verdict_rule: admitted = G_*; transferable = admitted+T_*; revised = transferable+D_*; recursive = revised+E_*; verdict = highest tier fully satisfied, else the conservative lower tier
prereg.a3_role: ceiling only: capture ratio reported, never a gate, never learner-visible
